checks.description: Primary-key uniqueness across master entities
checks.suggested_remediation: Ensure deterministic ID generation sequence is unique.

checks.description: Foreign-key integrity on Employee associations
checks.suggested_remediation: Verify child records only reference valid master data.

checks.description: Referential completeness: active employees have salary records
checks.suggested_remediation: Ensure salary history records are generated for every employee.

checks.description: Employee status and employment_type domain constraints
checks.suggested_remediation: Constrain values to documented enumeration sets.

checks.description: Salary-band boundary ordering (min < mid < max)
checks.suggested_remediation: Reconcile compensation band generation spread logic.

checks.description: Compensation band effective-date temporal integrity
checks.suggested_remediation: Ensure start_date <= end_date except deliberate test fixtures.

checks.description: Unique monthly salary identifiers per employee
checks.suggested_remediation: Format salary IDs deterministically with employee and effective month.

checks.description: Currency conversion arithmetic correctness
checks.suggested_remediation: Verify floating-point rounding convention in convert_currency.

checks.description: Salary annualization arithmetic consistency
checks.suggested_remediation: Annualized base salary must match annual amount without duplicate scaling.

checks.description: FTE-normalization arithmetic correctness
checks.suggested_remediation: Formula must follow: annualized_salary / fte.

checks.description: Compa-ratio arithmetic correctness (salary / midpoint)
checks.suggested_remediation: Compa-ratio = normalized_fte_salary / normalized_midpoint.

checks.description: Within-band position percentage and unclipped outlier retention
checks.suggested_remediation: Never clip within-band positions to avoid concealing outliers.

checks.description: Promotion resulting salary record linkage consistency
checks.suggested_remediation: Link promotion records directly to verified resulting salary changes.

checks.description: Company tenure dates consistent with employee hire dates
checks.suggested_remediation: Derive company tenure start date strictly from employment hire date.

checks.description: Adjustment proposal lifecycle states adherence
checks.suggested_remediation: Restrict proposal states to documented lifecycle transitions.

checks.description: Separation of duties: creator cannot approve their own proposal
checks.suggested_remediation: Enforce server-side separation of duties between creator and approver.

checks.description: Applied proposals reconcile with application events
checks.suggested_remediation: Ensure application events correspond exactly to approved applied adjustments.

checks.description: Consequential state changes captured in append-only audit log
checks.suggested_remediation: Ensure state transitions trigger AuditEvent persistence.

checks.description: Ground-truth isolation from analytical feature inputs
checks.suggested_remediation: Maintain isolated ground-truth files solely in data/ground_truth/.

checks.description: Comparable-group minimum size threshold and rationale rules
checks.suggested_remediation: Require minimum sample size or explicit unapproved warning.

checks.description: Deterministic zero-padded primary key identifier formatting
checks.suggested_remediation: Format employee IDs with EMP-000001 zero-padded schema.

checks.description: Generation manifest and SHA-256 provenance checksums present
checks.suggested_remediation: Generate generation_manifest.json with SHA-256 file hashes.
